messages:
Ashley: Helios Health flagged an invoice where streaming call charged ~4.9k tokens but dashboard shows ~2.4k. They say client aborted midstream and reconnected.

support-bot: Ticket T-5487 created -> https://zendesk.example/agent/tickets/5487

Ashley: Customer provided client logs + SSE payloads. Pasting redacted sequence from their logs: 
```
GET /v1/stream?session=aa7b
event: chunk
data: {\"tokens\": [\"hi\", \" there\"]}

event: chunk
data: {\"tokens\": [\"more\", \"text\"]}

-- socket close from client

-- reconnect ~2s later, server replays cached chunk then done
event: chunk
data: {\"tokens\": [\"more\", \"text\"]}
event: done
```

Prashant: Looking at internal stream_event rows for session aa7b shows two partial_finalize events from different stream_id values and then a finalize. Metering increments on each partial_finalize + finalize so that explains ~2x.

Prashant: DB excerpt (sanitized):
```
ts=1979804321, stream_id=st_a1, type=start
ts=1979804325, stream_id=st_a1, type=partial_finalize, tokens=1150
ts=1979804327, stream_id=st_b1, type=partial_finalize, tokens=1190
ts=1979804330, stream_id=st_b1, type=finalize, tokens=420
```

Kevin: So the reconnect created st_b1 and the cached partial was re-emitted and billed twice. Current metering has no cross-stream dedupe for streamed sessions.

Ingrid: Short term: approve a one-off credit while we fix. Long term: add idempotency by recording billed prefix hashes per logical session and refusing duplicate partial_finalize billing. Also add telemetry to count duplicate partial finalizes.

Sam: Also worth checking client SDK: some clients will ACK chunks on reconnect which can prompt server to re-finalize cached buffers. Could be both sides contributing.

Prashant: I'll build a minimal repro harness to replicate: open SSE, send chunk A, send chunk B, close socket, reconnect and force server cache replay. Metering worker logs will show two partial_finalize for chunk B. Will attach harness + logs.

Prashant: Repro steps for devs:
1) curl -N to open SSE -> send chunk A (n tokens)
2) send chunk B (m tokens) then close connection abruptly
3) reconnect within lease window; server replays cached chunk B then sends done
4) check metering/worker logs: both original chunk B and replayed chunk B are recorded as partial_finalize events

Kevin: Billing approved credit for T-5487. I'll process the refund and notify customer.

Ingrid: I'll open GH issue infra/metering and include the DB rows + proposed prefix_hash dedupe. Prashant link the repro harness to the issue.

support-bot: Created GH-1157: https://git.example/r/redwood/infra/issues/1157

Kevin: Action items:
- Prashant: repro harness + unit test (ETA EOD)
- Ingrid: implement prefix_hash dedupe + telemetry (ETA 2w)
- Kevin: issue credit & notify customer (today)

Ashley: I told Helios we'll credit if duplicate billing confirmed and will follow up with a postmortem when fix is deployed. Marking ticket follow-up in 2w. :thumbsup:

Sam: One more note: add an idempotency token from client SDK on reconnect to help server disambiguate replay vs new data. Could be a low-effort mitigation.

Ashley: Thanks team — closing internal thread once GH issue has PR link and credit processed.
